is: Composition (lib/main) plus the cross-cutting HTTP concerns (extractors, problem, wire_time, sweep) around the route groups and the generated contract module.
conventions: Handlers translate HTTP ↔ use-case Commands/Outputs only; no domain logic here.
The sweeper is the only place the system (not a participant) acts on a commission.

fs.name: dev_profile.rs
fs.role: cfg(feature = "dev-profile"): the environment lock (OutsideDev), adapter-mem stores seeded with identity's and commission's fixtures, FixedSignIn as alice, an unreachable profile source and pool, sessions in tower-sessions' MemoryStore, served through http_stack::stack

fs.name: extract.rs
fs.role: CallingUser extractor — session → Did → UserId, 401 on absence; CommissionPath extractor — the route's {id} segment → CommissionId, a missing or unparsable id the commission's one 404 (a non-UTF-8 segment too, unless another Path extractor runs first and answers axum's 400)

fs.name: extract/
fs.role: tests.rs: the source scan that fails when any file under routes/ puts CommissionId inside a Path<…>, so every commission route reads its id through CommissionPath

fs.name: generated/
fs.role: @generated prost structs + pbjson canonical-ProtoJSON serde; drift fails contract_current

fs.name: lib.rs
fs.role: app() composition + no-store header layer; the outer router's not-found fallback (a bare 404) sits outside the CSRF guard and no-store; ports/Config now shared via the composition crate

fs.name: main.rs
fs.role: boot: .env, config, tracing, then the profile's app — everyday: pool, migrations, Postgres session layer (http-cookies), live pg/atproto adapters, sweeper + reaper; with the `dev-profile` feature: dev_profile::app instead — then http_stack::serve until Ctrl-C or SIGTERM, finishing the requests in flight within the shutdown deadline

fs.name: problem.rs
fs.role: the single RFC 9457 error type and its code→URN mapping; its leaf problem/fields.rs builds field refusals

fs.name: problem/
fs.role: fields.rs: FieldPointer, FieldCode (From<NodeNameError>: each name-rule refusal its own code), FieldRefusal and Problem::invalid_fields, the one way a problem names the fields it refused; tests.rs, fields/tests.rs with the token pin and the source scan

fs.name: routes/
fs.role: per-domain route groups, each a *_router() builder

fs.name: sweep.rs
fs.role: deadline sweeper background task over the app's Runtime: each tick (sweep_tick) a pass when this instance wins pg_try_advisory_xact_lock (sweep_pass_as_leader, the one caller of Commissions::sweep_deadlines, at Utc::now()), a failing pass logged by its error's fixed text alone; sweep/tests.rs: a pass skips while another instance holds the lock, and a failing system act and a failing pass log no DID, name or store detail

fs.name: wire_time.rs
fs.role: canonical ProtoJSON Timestamp (Z-normalized, 0/3/6/9 digits) both directions; fallible TryFrom<WireTimestamp> for DateTimeUtc (OutOfWireRange) for use-case Commands
